closes: FETCH_ACTIVITIES falls to the default scope on every call.

appliesTo.note: This is the SUBSIDIARY_ACTIONS flow. Its eighteen cases are exactly that contract's routeKeys.

change.why: The Switch is on @triggerBody()?['action'] and string comparison in Power Automate is case-sensitive. FETCH_ACTIVITIES sends the fixed action LIST-ACTIVITIES, so it matches nothing and falls through to Scope_Default.

changeNothingElse.why: Sixteen further cases are sent by no contract at all - the routeKeys describe intent, the wire carries only contract.action, and INIT is a bulk data loader with no branch on payload.operation. Three of the sixteen are misspelled against the routes they were meant to serve (CREATE_TEST, UlPDATE_TASK, bulassign) and four hold zero actions. Normalising the whole Switch would make sixteen dormant paths live in one edit - none ever run against production data. Rename the one label a contract actually calls; the rest are dead code with a documented status, to be deleted or contracted deliberately.

verification: Call FETCH_ACTIVITIES and confirm the response is the list-activities scope rather than the default scope
